communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Pennsylvania Right to Know Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting records concerning the Cheltenham Township Police Department’s participation in the LexisNexis Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC), a platform through which law enforcement agencies contribute records management and dispatch data to a shared national database.

1) The ""AVCC XML Addendum"" or ""Consortium Sub-Agency Agreement"" signed between your agency and LexisNexis Risk Solutions (also known as RELX, LexisNexis Risk Management, or Accurint). This is the document that indicates whether your agency’s RMS/CAD data is shared only with consortium members or shared nationally. Either document alone is sufficient for this item.

2) Invoices issued by LexisNexis Risk Solutions to your agency during the last twelve months (if you receive monthly invoices, we only need the most recent two) 

3) A document, typically a spreadsheet, showing which crime types are and shared with LexisNexis. This is often called a Data Classification Crime Results sheet. A LexisNexis account administrator can produce it by opening ""Data Classification Manager"" under the admin permissions menu on the left-hand side and using the Export link at the top right of that page. Depending on which LexisNexis products your agency subscribes to, this report may have a different name or location. We are looking for the list of what data your agency shares, and who it is shared with. 

4) If your agency takes part in a different data sharing group (CrimeTracer, N-Dex, Linx, etc.) then please provide one contract, MOU, or other document per data-sharing group to help us understand which group(s) your agency shares local data CAD/RMS/JMS data with.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
